title: Queens with prize bulls.
html_source: A reference from Greek mythology to the bestial relationship between Queen Pasiphae of Crete and a pure white bull for whom she developed an irresistible physical desire. Interestingly, it was the artisan Daedalus who constructed a hollow cow that allowed Pasiphae to mate with the bull. Her monstrous offspring was the Minotaur. Daedalus, again, constructed a labyrinth to contain the monster.
